why: Both proposals share the same sofa, table, bookcase and lamp, so the difference is in the accents. A's grey-black patterned rug and monochrome woven cushions keep to the dark earthy industrial palette, and its matte black pot suits the metal-and-wood look. B's jute chevron rug is acceptable but looks busier with the wood beams. B's multicolor checked cushions are playful rather than industrial, and its iridescent faceted metal planter clashes with the rest.
